A solid block template `/home/user/Desktop/gravity_base.inp` is provided. Run `ccx --version` or invoke the installed `ccx` binary from a terminal. Use `/usr/bin/ccx` for the CalculiX solve and `/usr/bin/cgx` when CGX processing is needed.

Complete the following from the command line: 1. Modify and generate `/home/user/Desktop/gravity.inp`: Please save the final input file as /home/user/Desktop/gravity.inp. - Apply gravity acceleration `9.81 m/s²` in the `-Y` direction - Note unit conversion: density `7.85e-9 tonne/mm³`, `g=9810 mm/s²` - Fix one end 2. Submit the job and write a post-processing script to parse `gravity.dat`: - Extract global maximum Mises stress - Extract maximum `UY` at the free end (nodes `2,3,6,7`) - Write to `/home/user/Desktop/summary.txt` in this format: `max_mises, tip_uy`
